title: Feuerfalke's 3D Texture Pack
description: Updates follow frequently. Im the only one working on this.
body:
## About:

My 3D Texture Pack is an Addition to the Vanilla Game. It adds custom 3D Models to your items. It is made for People who like more Depth in their Game.

## Features:

- Elegant Models
- Selfmade Textures
- Compatible with all Kinds of other ressource packs
- Frequent Updates and new Models
